rows.note: Use this all-purpose expression when something is visually indistinct or its facts and status are unclear, rather than when it is specifically hard to understand.

example.english: The information on this old map is obscure.
example.traditional: 呢張舊地圖上面嘅資料唔清楚。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 gau6 dei6 tou4 soeng6 min6 ge3 zi1 liu2 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this when a passage, idea, reference, or explanation is difficult to understand.

example.english: This explanation is too obscure; I have read it several times and still do not understand.
example.traditional: 呢段解釋太難明，我睇咗幾次都係唔明。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 gaai2 sik1 taai3 naan4 ming4 ngo5 tai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 dou1 hai6 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use this when a person, place, work, or thing is not well-known.

example.english: This restaurant is still obscure, but the food is really good.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳仲唔出名，但啲嘢食真係好食。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zung6 m4 ceot1 meng2 daan6 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik6
